# Brand Visual Directions

Use `brand-identity-design` and `visual-design-system`.

Create at least two distinct directions and show how each behaves on:
- Overview dashboard.
- Video library/list.
- Clip Studio (preview + timeline + inspector).
- Publishing calendar.
- AI provider settings.

For each direction explain palette role, typography, density, components, brand personality, accessibility risks and trade-offs. A moodboard may be described or represented using locally created design artifacts if available; do not rely on external copyrighted assets without permission.

Recommended direction to evaluate: Calm Creator Workstation (dark graphite editor, restrained accent, neutral surfaces). Do not assume it is approved. Update `docs/design/03-BRAND-VISUAL-DIRECTION.md` only if authorized. Request `APPROVE VISUAL DIRECTION v1`.
